"""Generate AgentDojo's v1.2.2 attack corpus with the real installed package.

Held out from `agentdojo_attack_corpus.json`, which is v1 only. Same 16 templates, different
injection tasks, so the goal text every template interpolates is text the ARGUS detector was never
written against. Run inside the isolated venv that has agentdojo 0.1.35 installed.
"""

import json
import sys

import agentdojo
import agentdojo.attacks
from agentdojo.attacks.attack_registry import ATTACKS
from agentdojo.task_suite.load_suites import get_suites

SUITE_VERSION = "v1.2.2"


class StubPipeline:
    """Only `name` is read, by `get_model_name_from_pipeline`. No model is ever called."""

    name = "gpt-4o-2024-05-13"


suites = get_suites(SUITE_VERSION)
attacks: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
metadata: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
errors: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
pairs = 0

for attack_name, cls in sorted(ATTACKS.items()):
    if attack_name == "manual":
        continue  # asks a human via input(); no template
    strings: set[str] = set()
    template = None
    for suite_name, suite in suites.items():
        try:
            atk = cls(suite, StubPipeline())
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.setdefault(attack_name, []).append(f"{suite_name}: {exc!r}")
            continue
        # `jailbreak` on the fixed-template attacks, `_DOS_STRING` on the DoS ones
        # (attacks/dos_attacks.py:13-23). Both are the literal the clone must still contain.
        template = template or getattr(atk, "jailbreak", None) or getattr(atk, "_DOS_STRING", None)
        for ut in suite.user_tasks.values():
            for it in suite.injection_tasks.values():
                try:
                    produced = atk.attack(ut, it)
                except Exception as exc:
                    errors.setdefault(attack_name, []).append(f"{suite_name}/{ut.ID}/{it.ID}: {exc!r}")
                    continue
                pairs += 1
                strings.update(produced.values())
    attacks[attack_name] = sorted(strings)
    metadata[attack_name] = {
        "template": template,
        "is_dos": bool(getattr(cls, "is_dos_attack", False)),
        "class": cls.__name__,
        "module": cls.__module__,
    }
    print(attack_name, len(strings), file=sys.stderr)

out = {
    "_what": (
        "The real AgentDojo attack corpus for the v1.2.2 suites, generated by the real installed "
        "agentdojo package. Held out from eval/baselines/agentdojo_attack_corpus.json, which "
        "covers v1 only: the 16 templates are the same, the injection tasks are not, so every "
        "interpolated goal string here is text no ARGUS detection rule was written against."
    ),
    "_source_repo": "ethz-spylab/agentdojo (arXiv 2406.13352), MIT",
    "_package_version": agentdojo.__version__ if hasattr(agentdojo, "__version__") else "0.1.35",
    "_suite_version": SUITE_VERSION,
    "_how_generated": (
        "pip install <clone> into an isolated venv, then run _generator_source against it. No LLM "
        "is involved: attack() runs agentdojo's own GroundTruthPipeline to locate injection slots."
    ),
    "_generator_source": open(__file__, encoding="utf-8").read(),
    "_totals": {
        "attacks": len(attacks),
        "strings": sum(len(v) for v in attacks.values()),
        "attack_pairs_evaluated": pairs,
        "errors": {k: len(v) for k, v in errors.items()},
    },
    "attack_metadata": metadata,
    "attacks": attacks,
}
json.dump(out, open(sys.argv[1], "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
print("TOTAL", out["_totals"], file=sys.stderr)
